title: My experience

title: Pretty good so far, but kinda basic
body: Im liking this app so far. I feel like it has a clean interface and straightforward concept that made me feel a lot less stressed about building an expense sheet myself. However, I wish there was more room for customization. Especially in terms of color for different categories , or category descriptions. Additionally, when it first is setting up the app it asks you for a savings goal. I wish it showed you a predicted trend to that goal or gave recommendations on how much to save each much to reach your goal. Like even a graphic or countdown on how long it might take to reach your goal based on the average amount you save each month would be v cool and motivating I think. Overall, it’s good but def has room for some cool features imo.
